evidence: we propose a training-free, model-agnostic framework that operates entirely at inference time

title: Linear Probe Penalties Reduce LLM Sycophancy
evidence: We develop a linear probing method to identify and penalize markers of sycophancy within the reward model

title: Pointing to a Llama and Call it a Camel: On the Sycophancy of Multimodal Large Language Models
evidence: we propose Sycophantic Reflective Tuning (SRT), which enables the MLLM to engage in reflective reasoning

title: Benchmarking and Mitigating Sycophancy in Medical Vision Language Models
evidence: we propose a Visual Information Purification for Evidence based Responses (VIPER) strategy that proactively filters out non-evidence-based social cues

title: Consistency Training Helps Stop Sycophancy and Jailbreaks
evidence: While BCT and ACT reduce sycophancy equally well, BCT does better at jailbreak reduction.

title: FVA-RAG: Falsification-Verification Alignment for Mitigating Sycophantic Hallucinations
evidence: We propose FVA-RAG (Falsification-Verification Alignment RAG), a pipeline that inverts the standard RAG workflow by treating the initial response as a draft hypothesis

title: Internal Reasoning vs. External Control: A Thermodynamic Analysis of Sycophancy in Large Language Models
evidence: RCA detects this inconsistency, achieving 0.0% sycophancy while accepting 88% of valid hints.

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Sycophancy and Skepticism in LLM Causal Judgment
evidence: RCA reduces sycophantic acceptance to near zero while preserving valid hint acceptance

title: Self-Blinding and Counterfactual Self-Simulation Mitigate Biases and Sycophancy in Large Language Models
evidence: We show that this access to the responses of a blinded replica enables fairer decisions

title: A Few Bad Neurons: Isolating and Surgically Correcting Sycophancy
evidence: We demonstrate this approach on the task of reducing sycophantic behavior, where our method matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance on four benchmarks

title: The Silicon Mirror: Dynamic Behavioral Gating for Anti-Sycophancy in LLM Agents
evidence: We present The Silicon Mirror, an orchestration framework that dynamically detects user persuasion tactics and adjusts AI behavior to maintain factual integrity.

title: Too Polite to Disagree: Understanding Sycophancy Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
evidence: providing sycophancy priors reduces the influence of sycophancy-prone peers, mitigates error-cascades, and improves final discussion accuracy by an absolute 10.5%

title: Pressure, What Pressure? Sycophancy Disentanglement in Language Models via Reward Decomposition
evidence: We propose the first approach to sycophancy reduction via reward decomposition

title: Playing Devil's Advocate: Off-the-Shelf Persona Vectors Rival Targeted Steering for Sycophancy
evidence: these results show that general persona vectors can help mitigate sycophancy in LLMs, even when extracted without sycophancy-specific labels

title: Consistency Training while Mitigating Obfuscation via Rate Matching
evidence: We evaluate RMCT on sycophancy reduction in two open-weight language models, achieving reductions in bias-following comparable to a standard consistency-training baseline

title: Durable Evaluation Framework: Adversarial Arbitration for Sycophancy Reduction in Large Language Models
evidence: a multi-agent architecture that mitigates identity-framed sycophancy by arbitrating between two models tuned to opposing DEFs

title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features
evidence: We focus on detecting and steering away from sycophancy

title: Mitigating LLM Sycophancy in Code Smell Detection Using Evidence-Guided Reasoning Prompts
evidence: we propose Evidence-Guided Debiasing Prompting (EGDP), a structured prompting strategy that enforces evidence-first reasoning

title: TD-DPO: Difference-Aware Preference Optimization for Mitigating Sycophancy in Clinical Autism Intervention Dialogue
evidence: TD-DPO achieves a better trade-off between sycophancy mitigation and intervention ability retention in our offline settings

title: THESIS-MoE: Trainable Hierarchical Extraction and SteerIng of Sycophancy in Mixture-of-Experts
evidence: a learned per-token gate that steers the model away from sycophancy while keeping its weights frozen

title: PCA-guided Activation Scaling for Monotonic Bidirectional Control over LLM Sycophancy
evidence: We introduce PCA-guided Activation Scaling (PAS), an activation steering framework that decomposes residual stream activations into a PCA-identified sycophancy-honesty subspace and an orthogonal residual
